title: Unknown Venetian envoy to the Doge (Ser.mo Principe), 29 April 1628 (DECODE R1862)

steps.what: Fetched the four images with the stored DECODE cookie; the record has no transcription.
CSP Venice vol. 21, 23-30 April 1628: only the London despatch of 29 April is calendared; this letter is not.

Group-exact transcription of R1862 by an agent (digit shapes b=6, s=5, hook=2, >=7, g=9; 5-forms "s3"=53, "si"=51). The R1874 transcription agent stopped (ambiguous hand); DECODE's own R1874 transcription used instead.
Transcribed R1874's contemporary decipherment (images 8955-8959, paragraphs 5-16, ~4,800 letters) as known plaintext.

Soft-EM forward-backward alignment of R1874 code groups (DECODE transcription, 5-forms unmerged: '21'=51, '13'=53) to the decipherment, 5 segment pairs, 2,398 groups; first run with nulls allowed collapsed, rerun with 1-4 letters per group converged.

Key is a vowel x consonant syllabary: prefix 6=a, 51=e, 62=i, 53=o, 64=u; final pair 08 c,10 d,11 f,13 g,18 h,19 l,20 m,21 n,22 p,24 qu,27 r,28 s,33 t,37 v,38 z; single letters 680 a, 6280 e, 6480 i, 5190 o; words 670 che, 672 con, 5374 per, 6249 il.
R1874 key applied unchanged to R1862 page 1: continuous Italian ('ricercavo con intiera confidenza', 'serenissima republica').
Key applied to all four pages; nomenclator codes read from context (5384 qual(che), 5331 sto, 5373 part, 5387 quel, 537 ro, 6477 poc, 6240 ave, 5347 papa, 6481 stri).
Agents re-checked every line against the images with the key (glyph calibration: final n-shape = 2, 7 = long-tailed >, 9 = g), correcting digit slips and group splits.
Five image passes over the transcription with the key in hand; found and fixed two rows blended from two physical lines and one phantom row on page 2.
LM hill-climb over key values for weak/unknown groups.
Pages 1, 3 and 4 and the first half of page 2 read continuously; 20 word-code tokens and page 2 lines 18-28 left unread.
Swept the DECODE API for every ASVe record: the Codice Amadi (Inquisitori di Stato reg. 1269, 14 key records) and the Busta 4 key registers are 16th-century or earlier and hold no key of this type.
The word codes are alphabetical within each prefix row's blocks (53: papa 47, part 73, per 74, piu 77, qual 84, quel 87, ques 88), which brackets every open code.

Second round of image passes: word codes read from context and bracket (6274 molto, 5140 dov, 673 cose, 5323 pro, 5117 gre, 5208 co, 5174 far, 5347 papa), key corrections 628 sa, 6439 signor, 6481 i; one manuscript line on page 3 found untranscribed and transcribed (P3 L26b, 'la prego non nominarme').

Read fraction measured two ways: 91.3% of code groups stand in lines that score as Italian (line level, neighbour-context), 86.4% by a 25-character sliding window; 15 group tokens (1.2%) still have no value.

Final image round on the last garbled spans: 'se Palma sara ben fortificata, quanto presidio aveva', 'il disgusto di Aquileia', 'in strettissima confidenza', 'havuto particolar notitia', 'et qua et altrove', 'Mantova et di Savoia', 'esprimersi'.

Key values proved against the letter: 634 tra, 5132 stre, 683 a (Aquileia), 5388 quest, 5386 quant, 5189 glie, 61 fat, 6212 fri (Friuli); 6443 returned to the open list as its sibling value came from a mis-split stretch.
Read bar checked three ways: 0.95 line-level with neighbour context, 0.92 by a 25-character window, 0.96 by hand audit; 12 tokens (0.9%) still have no value.

outcome.notes: Key rebuilt from the sibling R1874 by EM alignment, then extended from context and from the alphabetical order of the word band. 99.1% of the code-group tokens have a value. Share reading as sense: 0.95 measured line by line against a period Italian model with neighbour context (measure.py), 0.92 by a stricter 25-character sliding window (measure_tok.py), 0.96 by a hand audit token by token. The clerk's own one-digit encipherment slips are recorded in key_over.json _slips and read through, as his spelling slips (sivoia, germinia, voro) are.

gaps.detail: R1874's decipherment does not cover that band of the key, no other letter in this cipher survives on DECODE, and the ASVe key registers that do (Codice Amadi reg. 1269, Busta 4 regs. 8/16/18) are a century older. Their alphabetical brackets are recorded in NOTES.

gaps.item: one line, P2 L22 (14 groups), image-true after four independent readings and still giving no sense
gaps.detail: every group in it is a structural grid value, so it turns on a clerk's slip or a word outside the corpus; exhaustive single- and double-substitution searches returned nothing
he does not name himself; CSP Venice vol. 21 calendars no Rome despatch of 29 Apr 1628

prior.where: CSP Venice vol. 21 calendars no Rome despatch of 29 Apr 1628; not in Tomokiyo or Bonavoglia.

human: Posed the target from the catalogue; DECODE account cookie.
